signal_attribution.reasoning_chain: Negative GEX with backwardated VIX puts the market in an explosive regime, where backtests favour bullish trend-following. CAG fear at z=+6.35 adds a contrarian bullish edge. Spot sits between the 7,250 put wall and 7,275 call wall, which caps the intraday move but leaves tails wide. Index options flow is mostly hedging (multileg 87-88%), so it is not read as bearish, while NVDA stock-replacement calls support the AI trade. The 17% regime confidence and a mixed downtrend/rates picture cap confidence at 42-60%, and recent targets overshot upward so point targets are shaded toward spot.
